comparison.objective: Choose fitting tweezers, peel protective film while stabilizing its carrier, and restore the tools.
comparison.physical_skill: Tool selection by clearance, spring-tweezer actuation, bimanual peel-force control, and carrier stabilization.
comparison.success_condition: Film fully detached and placed outside carrier; carrier excursion limited; both tweezers restored; hands clear.
comparison.reason: Small-part bimanual work is shared generically, but peeling an adhesive film with selected tweezers does not test coaxial mandrel impact, notch fracture, or fragment recovery.
